A probability of $35.94\%$ has a $z$-score of $-0.36$.

$$z = \dfrac{x - \bar{x}}{\sigma}$$

$$0.3 = \dfrac{22 - \bar{x}}{\sigma} \qquad -0.36 = \dfrac{17 - \bar{x}}{\sigma}$$

Solving simultaneously:

$$\begin{aligned} 0.3\sigma &= 22 - \bar{x} \\ -0.36\sigma &= 17 - \bar{x} \end{aligned}$$

$\therefore \sigma = 7.58$, $\therefore \bar{x} = 19.73$

$$\begin{aligned} &= 2000 \times 1.065^n + 2000 \times 1.065^{n-1} + \ldots + 2000 \times 1.065 \\ &= 2000(1.065 + 1.065^2 + \ldots + 1.065^n) \\ &= 2000 \times \dfrac{1.605(1.065^n - 1)}{1.065 - 1} \end{aligned}$$

$$\dfrac{2130}{0.065}(1.065^n - 1) > 100000$$

$$n > 22.2$$
